purpose: Switches between a few views or options with connected segments. Single mode picks one; multiple mode toggles several.

props.name: options
props.type: Array<{ value: string; label: string; icon?: IconName; disabled?: boolean }>
props.description: Segments, each with an optional icon

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: single keeps exactly one selected; multiple toggles independently. Defaults to single

whenToUse: To switch between two to five views of the same content (day, week, month)
For a compact set of formatting toggles (multiple mode)
whenNotToUse: For navigation between pages — use tabs or links
For more than five options — use Select
antiPatterns: Mixing actions and selections in one control
Segments with very different label lengths

anatomy: A bordered row of connected segments, each with optional icon and label
states: Selected: `color-container-primary` with `color-on-container-primary`; hover and press `color-state-layer`; focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`; disabled at `opacity-disabled`
motion: Fill and layer over `motion-duration-standard`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: Single mode is a radiogroup of radios; multiple mode is a group of toggle buttons with aria-pressed
